description: Raw UTF-8 JSON texts that preserve duplicate names and numeric tokens; two independent parsers must agree before JCS canonicalization.

vectors.name: empty-object
vectors.note: A well-formed JSON object is admitted.

vectors.name: maximum-safe-positive-integer
vectors.note: The positive DACS safe-magnitude boundary is inclusive.

vectors.name: maximum-safe-negative-integer
vectors.note: The negative DACS safe-magnitude boundary is inclusive.

vectors.name: maximum-safe-exponent-spelling
vectors.note: An exponent spelling exactly at the safe boundary is admitted.

vectors.name: exponent-equivalent-one
vectors.note: A valid exponent spelling may normalize under JCS.

vectors.name: uppercase-exponent-plus
vectors.note: Lexical spelling is not confused with numeric profile admission.

vectors.name: negative-zero
vectors.note: Negative zero is admitted and JCS serializes it as zero.

vectors.name: valid-fraction-one-tenth
vectors.note: Finite bounded fractions remain valid after #345.

vectors.name: valid-fraction-trailing-zero
vectors.note: A valid fractional lexical form may normalize under JCS.

vectors.name: minimum-positive-binary64
vectors.note: The minimum non-zero binary64 subnormal is representable.

vectors.name: escaped-member-name
vectors.note: Duplicate detection compares decoded names; one escaped name is valid.

vectors.name: valid-surrogate-pair
vectors.note: A valid pair decodes to one Unicode scalar value.

vectors.name: values-only-nfc-after-admission
vectors.note: CF-5 admission precedes the existing values-only CF-1 NFC step.

vectors.name: nfc-and-nfd-member-names-distinct
vectors.note: Member names remain distinct and are not NFC-folded.

vectors.name: nested-distinct-members
vectors.note: The same member spelling may occur in distinct objects.

vectors.name: positive-two-to-the-53
vectors.note: 2^53 is outside the inclusive DACS magnitude bound.

vectors.name: negative-two-to-the-53
vectors.note: -2^53 is outside the inclusive DACS magnitude bound.

vectors.name: positive-rounded-unsafe-integer
vectors.note: The raw token is checked before a binary64 parser can round it.

vectors.name: negative-rounded-unsafe-integer
vectors.note: The raw negative token is checked before binary64 rounding.

vectors.name: unsafe-exponent-spelling
vectors.note: Exponent notation cannot bypass the mathematical magnitude check.

vectors.name: binary64-overflow
vectors.note: A syntactically valid number that overflows binary64 is refused.

vectors.name: binary64-underflow
vectors.note: A non-zero token that collapses to binary64 zero is refused.

vectors.name: duplicate-top-level-member
vectors.note: A parser's first/last-member policy cannot choose the signed amount.

vectors.name: duplicate-nested-member
vectors.note: Duplicate rejection applies at every object nesting level.

vectors.name: duplicate-member-inside-array
vectors.note: Objects inside arrays receive the same duplicate check.

vectors.name: duplicate-escape-equivalent-member
vectors.note: Names are compared after JSON escape decoding, before object collapse.

vectors.name: lone-high-surrogate-value
vectors.note: A lone high surrogate is not a Unicode scalar value.

vectors.name: lone-low-surrogate-value
vectors.note: A lone low surrogate is not a Unicode scalar value.

vectors.name: lone-surrogate-member-name
vectors.note: Member names must also contain only Unicode scalar values.

vectors.name: nan-extension
vectors.note: NaN is a parser extension, not JSON.

vectors.name: positive-infinity-extension
vectors.note: Infinity is a parser extension, not JSON.

vectors.name: negative-infinity-extension
vectors.note: Negative Infinity is a parser extension, not JSON.

vectors.name: trailing-non-whitespace
vectors.note: Non-whitespace bytes after the JSON value are refused.

vectors.name: two-json-values
vectors.note: A second JSON value cannot be ignored.

vectors.name: utf8-bom
vectors.note: A BOM is not silently stripped from signed wire bytes.

vectors.name: invalid-utf8
vectors.note: Ill-formed UTF-8 is rejected before JSON parsing.

vectors.name: leading-zero-number
vectors.note: A non-JSON leading-zero form is refused rather than normalized.

vectors.name: leading-plus-number
vectors.note: A leading plus sign is not JSON number syntax.

vectors.name: unterminated-object
vectors.note: Incomplete JSON never reaches canonicalization.

vectors.name: unescaped-control
vectors.note: Unescaped C0 controls are invalid JSON string content.

vectors.name: invalid-string-escape
vectors.note: Non-JSON escape extensions are refused.

vectors.name: comment-extension
vectors.note: Comments are not JSON and cannot be stripped before hashing.
